description: This file defines the PanoramaClient class for interacting with the AWS Panorama service. It includes method annotations for various API operations and extends the AwsClient class.

classes.name: PanoramaClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Panorama service that provides method signatures for each API operation.

methods.name: createApplicationInstance
methods.description: Creates a new application instance in AWS Panorama.

methods.name: createJobForDevices
methods.description: Creates a new job for devices in AWS Panorama.

methods.name: createNodeFromTemplateJob
methods.description: Creates a new node from a template job.

methods.name: createPackage
methods.description: Creates a new package in AWS Panorama.

methods.name: describeApplicationInstanceDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed information about an application instance.

methods.name: describeDeviceJob
methods.description: Provides details of a device job.

methods.name: describeNodeFromTemplateJob
methods.description: Provides details of a node from template job.

methods.name: describePackageImportJob
methods.description: Provides details of a package import job.

methods.name: listApplicationInstanceDependencies
methods.description: Lists dependencies for an application instance.

methods.name: listApplicationInstanceNodeInstances
methods.description: Lists node instances within an application instance.
